plaatsen.tekst: He was taken from prison and from judgment: and who shall declare his generation? for he was cut off out of the land of the living: for the transgression of my people was he stricken.
The grave; and the barren womb; the earth that is not filled with water; and the fire that saith not, It is enough.
Again, they are minished and brought low through oppression, affliction, and sorrow.
